offers_products.reason: Provides power and equipment mainly on a rental or operated basis; proprietary systems are not sold as products.

offers_services.reason: Owns and operates power generation for customers, plus field services, logistics and engineering for wellsites.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are data centers, energy, commercial and industrial businesses; no households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to hyperscaler data center operators, oil and gas operators, and commercial and industrial companies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Rental power and equipment under ongoing contracts to data center and oilfield customers generate repeat revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Main demand is data center AI power, with long-term contracts; oilfield equipment is cyclical but smaller.

big_ticket.reason: Customers rent power and equipment under ongoing contracts rather than making single large purchases, though deployments are large.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from owned turbines, BESS and rental equipment fleets, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Hyperscaler AI data center clients and large oil and gas operators are its main customers.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and operates fleets of power generation turbines, BESS and rental equipment, requiring heavy ongoing capital investment to expand.

notes: Formerly Solaris Oilfield Infrastructure; recognized as a power and oilfield equipment rental company. Revenue mix inferred, not from website figures.
